CHUNITHMオリジナル楽曲

制作のコンセプト：
1. グラウンドスライダー上でピアノ演奏を完全再現を可能にするために、白鍵盤しか使わずに楽曲を構成すること。

snippet.description:
CHUNITHMオリジナル楽曲
 ©SEGA

--------------------------------------------------------------
制作のコンセプト：
1. グラウンドスライダー上でピアノ演奏を完全再現を可能にするために、白鍵盤しか使わずに楽曲を構成すること。

2. グラウンドスライダー上でピアノ演奏を完全再現を可能にするために、手を持ち上げる跳躍時以外16度以内の音程だけを用いて楽曲を構成すること。
--------------------------------------------------------------

上二段が実際に鳴っているピアノ楽譜、下二段は、上段のピアノに無いオーケストラだけの旋律の簡略化した楽譜です。

snippet.title: #G2R2018  Destr0yer (feat. Nikki Simmons)
snippet.description:
BMS: http://manbow.nothing.sh/event/event.cgi?action=More_def&num=353&event=123
SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/sakuzyo/destr0yer

------------------------------------------------------
Sound: Sakuzyo (http://sakuzyo.com/)
Lyric: Sakuzyo & ASPRGuS (https://twitter.com/Asprgus_as)
Vocal: Nikki Simmons (https://www.youtube.com/user/nikkivocals/)
Movie: yoshimo & Radiosity (https://twitter.com/4Ckey_music https://twitter.com/yousei_kainushi) 

----------------------------------

Lyrics:

I wonder why things have happened.  
Could you imagine the world is boring?
Stereotype, Sham, Brain Freeze, Collusion, Mental block
The world is fading. 
I know the fate.
The world is fading.
I know the fate.

I know all of you.
Have you followed me?
Me in your mind is the dream.
The dream of the past.
So I would forget you.
Let you forget me.
'Cause I'm "Destroyer"

I kill us all. 
It's the only way. 
It's over.

I will kill. 
I will destroy the world.
No matter what you do, I don't stop.
I'm the only one who is right.
I will kill.
I will destroy the world. 
No matter what you do, I don't stop. 
It is what it is. 
It is what it is.
It is not. It's not my fault.

----------------------------------
